name: Software Architecture with C++ 2E (book technique: std::pmr monotonic and pool resources, with winking out)
listed_description: Code a C++ book benchmarks or cites: leveraging polymorphic allocators (std::pmr monotonic_buffer_resource and unsynchronized_pool_resource, winking out), Software Architecture with C++, 2nd ed., chapter 6.
reason: Directional claim only: the book says pool resources should give much better performance than the global allocator, especially over a monotonic upstream buffer, with no numbers. The repo carries the technique code (Chapter06/13_memory_arenas.cpp, 13_memory_arena_winking_out.cpp) but both files are demonstrations (verbose_resource logging, null_memory_resource, set_default_resource); grep for benchmark, timing, ns, speed and faster found nothing, Chapter06 README and CMakeLists have no results, and no file in the repo compares pmr against std::allocator. Repo MIT, 74 stars, last commit 2026-09-27.
